name: smart-clearance-demo
made_with: Qwen-Image 2.1 (bf16, local) for the first minute's eight keyframes and the depot, edits with the cast sheet, the app's own screen and a 16:9 reference of the real label beside the pack as condition images (gen-qwen.sh, refs16/)
LTX 2.5 Fast (local, 720p, no audio) for those eight clips, near-static prompts (gen-ltx3.py); each reviewed by Gemini (eyes.py) and cut to its clean seconds, slowed with motion interpolation
Nano Banana 2 and Veo 3.1 (Vertex AI) for cut 2's remaining live-action clips; three clips reused from SC-154's landing-page film
the workspace and console apps on the live stack, recorded with a gliding pointer (tour.mjs, tour.json; director.py --until for the walk); the slow week on the stub
four animations on the design system's tokens, rendered frame by frame with Playwright (anim.mjs): the ten agents round the one yes, the nine stops, the five exits priced against the bin, the ledger
Cloud Text-to-Speech, Gemini-TTS Kore at 1.08, for the voice-over (vo.py), every take transcribed back and checked
Lyria 2 (lyria-002, Vertex AI) for the music bed, looped with the lift at the ledger (bed.py)

ffmpeg for the cut (film3.py, overlays.mjs, assemble.py): chapters opening over their screens, notification banners, labels rising, a push between app screens, the chapter's keyframe out of focus behind each window
postprocess: libx264 crf 18 master (local, src/build3/); the tracked copy crf 24, aac 192k, loudnorm I=-14 TP=-1.5; the 720p copy crf 25, aac 128k
cost_usd_clips: counted in the clips' own sidecars (see storyboard.md, The spend); cut 3's own Google spend under $1
fictional: every person, company, signature and figure is fictional; no client is named in the narration
